claims.statement: Tom Allen was arrested on Saturday evening, 9 February 1884, at the instance of W. P. Farrell of Covington, Ky.
claims.excerpt: was arrested on Saturday evening at the instigation of W. P. Farrell of Covington

claims.statement: Farrell charged that Allen was wanted to answer an indictment in Kentucky.
claims.excerpt: who charges that Tom is wanted to answer an indictmont-in Hentucky

claims.statement: Allen's prize fight with Joe Goss, printed as 10 September 1876 (year garbled), led to an indictment in Kentucky.
claims.excerpt: growing out of his prize t with Goss, on September 10,

claims.statement: After the Goss fight Allen gave $3,000 bond to answer an indictment, with W. P. Farrell and P. C. Murphy as bondsmen.
claims.excerpt: Allen gavé lmgnad in the suaref £3,000 to answer to an indictment

claims.statement: Allen went to England and allowed his bond to be forfeited.
claims.excerpt: Alien went to Engiand and allowed his bond to be forfeited

claims.statement: His bondsmen's property was sold to make good Allen's debt to the State.
claims.excerpt: The property of his bondsmen was sold to make good bis debt to the State

claims.statement: Allen said he had already paid each of his sureties $250 and would pay the whole debt if they gave him time.
claims.excerpt: says he has already paid them $250 each

claims.statement: Farrell sent for a Kentucky requisition and procured Allen's arrest after Allen refused his money demand.
claims.excerpt: adopted an agressive plan, sent for a requisition and procured the arrest

claims.statement: Allen gave $2,000 bond (printed as $2°000) with Fred Walters and Jos. Schnaider as sureties.
